rule: Resolve exact terms and authority before from_pretrained or load_dataset; a Trainer callback is too late to prevent acquisition.
Resolve a hold before calling Trainer.train(); on_train_begin may re-observe state as defense in depth but does not guarantee zero optimizer updates.
Only an explicit checkpoint choice with clean admission and authority may request save; other holds stop after the current optimizer step without requesting a new checkpoint.
Treat evaluation like a completed safe boundary: an explicit authorized checkpoint may request save, while every other hold requests stop without persistence.
Use on_save for a checkpoint-and-pause receipt or finalizer, not state that must already exist inside the checkpoint just written; this offer remains stopped.
Restore callback state explicitly and resolve a newly bound exact offer before Trainer.train(); never auto-resume.
Require a stopped effect receipt and keep this offer terminal; any later work starts from a new exact resume offer.
